posts.post_subject: General Holography -Why not dump ALL questions in  it?
posts.content_md:
Colin, In my humble opinion your commendable effort to bring order and tidyness to the Forum by subcatagorizing is at odds with the problems that we all have with needing to do quick scans of things in our busy lives. If you let ALL the questions go into a General Holography dump then we could all just quickly scan the lot and click onto anything that catches our eye. As it is now, segregating off Silver Chemistry, DCG , beginners questions , photopolymers , laser questions, pulsed Holography is just irksome. We are just going to miss more and more postings and lose interest in helping and learning from others. 

We are all interested to some extent in most of these catagories. So I think that segregation is a mistake. Let us hear what others think.

Jeff

posts.content_md:
Hi Jeff,

This does make it easier for new posters to find information before they post a question. It is really hard to read through long DCG posts when you are trying to figure out how to keep an object stable.

For those of us trying to answer questions it is much easier to have them in all one place because we are only looking at the new posts.

How would people feel about this as a compromise, Move pulsed, general, DCG and silver halide into one forum. I still would like to keep beginners seperate as I find they are more likely to post there and I really try to encourage new people to post.

Thoughts?

Bob Hess, I am specifically interested in your opinion on this.

posts.post_subject: General Holography -Why not dump ALL questions in  it?
posts.content_md:
I personally like the individualized sections.

But, did you get what Paulos stated? It's IS the perfect solution, best of both worlds. Keep all the sections as is but create a sections that has all posts in every section organized by time stamp. I know in a database scenerio, this is not duplicating information but actually just a differently formatted view of the database. And a post to either the individual section or the "All Posts" section updates the database and thus is viewable in both areas. This would be for responds. To keep the organized sections organized, if a new post was put in, it would have to be entered in the individual specialized section or have a drop down box that requires you to put it in a specialized section.
